title: Papers, please hommage
author: Ostermiss
selftext:
Hello, 

I love the concept of papers, please. For me it is a unique game, and I wanted to develop a game based on the same gameplay loop.

I am also a fan of mars attacks and wanted to develop something about this.

First I tried to produced pixel art sprite with ChatGPT but it didn’t work well. Then I produced a diorama with opus 5.5 https://marsattacksidle.vercel.app and after few iterations I was happy with the results.

Now I can decline a lot of different sprite based on it, and with Claude, I did https://retro-mars.vercel.app . The purpose of The game is to handle a retro game shop on mars as a Martian and buy games and avoid fake ones. But Mars is a autoritarism planet and maybe you can change something or not !

For the moment the gameplay on mobile is awful and only in French.

I would be happy to hear anything about what you think about this !
